    "F0 shape bbox is 76.5 x 18 x 23 mm with volume ~9698 mm³, showing a dumbbell/axle form: large disc at one end, shaft, small disc at other end.",
    "F0 renders confirm: large circular hub (~23mm dia) at J03 end, cylindrical shaft, smaller hub (~18mm dia) with flange at J04 end.",
    "Refinement: rebuild as fused primitives preserving the hub-shaft-hub topology with correct joint positions (J03 at x=0, J04 at x=63).",
    "Total length ~77mm matches F0 bbox X of 76.5mm; Y=18mm and Z=23mm preserved for shaft and hub dimensions."
  ],
  "freecad_python": "import FreeCAD
import Part
import math

# Reference the starting F0 shape
_ = f0_shape.BoundBox

# L04 forearm link in local coordinates
# J03 (elbow revolute) at origin, axis Y
# J04 (wrist fixed) at x=63mm

# Large cylindrical hub at elbow end (J03 side)

# Main rectangular beam connecting the two joints
beam = Part.makeBox(55.0, 16.0, 16.0, FreeCAD.Vector(6.0, -8.0, -8.0))

# Smaller cylindrical hub at wrist end (J04 side)
hub_wrist = Part.makeCylinder(9.0, 10.0, FreeCAD.Vector(61.0, 0.0, 0.0), FreeCAD.Vector(1, 0, 0))

# End flange/disc at the far end
flange = Part.makeCylinder(11.0, 4.0, FreeCAD.Vector(71.0, 0.0, 0.0), FreeCAD.Vector(1, 0, 0))

# Fuse all components into a single solid
result = hub_elbow.fuse(beam)
result = result.fuse(hub_wrist)
result = result.fuse(flange)

result_shape = result",
  "assumptions": [
    "L04 local frame origin coincides with J03 joint center; J04 is at +63mm along local X.",
    "Large hub diameter ~23mm matches F0 bbox Z; small hub ~18mm; flange ~22mm.",
    "Shaft cross-section 16x16mm is slightly smaller than F0 Y/Z to reflect beam narrowing between hubs.",
    "Total extent from x=-6 to x=75 (~81mm) slightly exceeds F0 bbox but preserves joint clearance zones.",
    "No fillets, holes, or cosmetic details per scope exclusion."
  ]
}
